title: 5 Day Rwanda Honeymoon Safari: Gorillas and Lake Kivu
rank_math_title: Rwanda Honeymoon Safari: 5 Days, Gorillas and Lake Kivu
rank_math_desc: Rwanda honeymoon safari for 5 days: Kigali, two nights in Volcanoes National Park with gorilla trekking, and a night on the shores of Lake Kivu.
post_content: This Rwanda honeymoon safari is short, smooth and unforgettable.
overview:
This Rwanda honeymoon safari is short, smooth and unforgettable. After a night in Kigali, drive to Volcanoes National Park for two nights at Mountain Gorilla View Lodge and a morning with a mountain gorilla family. Then relax on the shores of Lake Kivu at the Lake Kivu Serena Hotel before returning to Kigali. Distances are short and the roads are good, so it fits easily into a week's leave or combines with a beach extension.

Price: from USD 3,400 per adult sharing (low season estimate). Contact us for your exact dates.
highlights: Gorilla trekking permit in Volcanoes National Park included
Two nights at Mountain Gorilla View Lodge
A night on the shores of Lake Kivu
Short, easy drives on good roads

faq.q: How much does this Rwanda honeymoon safari cost?
faq.a: It starts from USD 3,400 per adult sharing, including the USD 1,500 gorilla permit, based on low-season rates. We confirm the price for your dates when you enquire.

faq.q: How far ahead should we book?
faq.a: Gorilla permits are limited, so book three to six months ahead, especially for June to September.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Kigali
itinerary.content: Meet at Kigali airport; afternoon city tour including the Kigali Genocide Memorial. Dinner and overnight at Hotel des Mille Collines.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Kigali to Volcanoes National Park
itinerary.content: Drive about two and a half hours to Musanze at the foot of the Virunga volcanoes. Afternoon at leisure. Dinner and overnight at Mountain Gorilla View Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Gorilla trekking
itinerary.content: Briefing at Kinigi park headquarters, then trek to spend one hour with a habituated mountain gorilla family. Dinner and overnight at Mountain Gorilla View Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Volcanoes to Lake Kivu
itinerary.content: Drive to Gisenyi on Lake Kivu. Afternoon boat trip or time on the lake shore. Dinner and overnight at Lake Kivu Serena Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Lake Kivu to Kigali
itinerary.content: Drive back to Kigali for your departure flight.

includes: Private 4x4 vehicle with English-speaking driver guide
One gorilla trekking permit per person
excludes: International flights, visa and travel insurance
Tips for guides and camp staff
Drinks unless stated, laundry and personal expenses
Optional activities not listed in the itinerary
